mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Thread on the Moparts board titled as a King bearings problem. Only the title was visible in the search result, so the specific fault is not established; the thread is new to the ledger and reads as a product complaint rather than a general question.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling owners to inspect every King bearing before installation. Search snippet describes a case of incorrectly sized bearings found mixed into standard-marked packaging. High severity because it is framed as a warning to all buyers, not a single complaint.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread claiming King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, sliding into the block and cap too easily and risking a spun thrust bearing. The snippet states a King technical representative said he would not use them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports in-spec measurements on replacement thrust bearings.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Owner reports King STDX main/thrust bearings for a BMW engine measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, with the fit problem reproduced across more than one block.
